description: This file defines the 'Extension' class within the OpenCart system, specifically in the 'Catalog' module's startup namespace. The class handles registration of extensions, including loading extension models, registering controllers, models, libraries, and setting up paths for templates, language, and configuration. It also registers and sets up OCMOD components for extensions in OpenCart.
